approved_datasets.scope: Only the specific DES crop-wise area/production/yield dataset version recorded in the downloaded manifest; this is not blanket approval for other government data.

notes: A licence declaration does not prove the uploader owns third-party image rights.
Do not add raw competition data or unverified third-party images to public Git history.
Update this policy only after checking the exact source version and rights.
CSV and common tabular/geospatial data files are treated as raw data when placed in configured public raw-data directories.
